Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFTimestampOptions

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFTimestampOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public final class CPDFTimestampOptions extends Object implements Cloneable
RFC 3161 TSA request and HTTP transport settings.

HTTPS uses native OpenSSL trust paths, not the JVM trust store. A successful TSA response is not a certificate-trust verdict. Use full PDF validation for embedded/document timestamps. Settings are copied at submission.
